title: InvenTrust Properties Corp. Announces First Quarter 2025 Earnings Release and Conference Call Dates
summary: InvenTrust Properties Corp. (“InvenTrust” or the “Company”) (NYSE: IVT) today announced that it will report its first quarter 2025 earnings results on April 30, 2025, after the market closes. The Company’s earnings release and any supplemental information will be posted on the Investor Relations section of the Company’s website – www.inventrustproperties.com/investor-relations/ . InvenTrust will host an earnings conference call to discuss the Company’s results and business highlights on May 1, 2025, at 10:00 a.m. ET. An archive of the webcast will be available on the Company’s website. First Quarter 2025 Earnings Conference Call Date: Thursday, May 1, 2025 Time: 10:00 a.m. ET Dial-In Number: 833-470-1428 Access Code: 200651 Webcast Replay Link: https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/483826441 About InvenTrust Properties Corp.
